ic_name: NFC / ISO 14443 (NXP AN10833 MIFARE family — subset)
notes: ISO/IEC 14443 itself does not standardise a host-bus register map; what it standardises are on-card identification structures (ATQA, UID + SAK per Cascade Level, ATS) and a small set of MIFARE family classification 'pseudo-registers' that AN10833 documents as the deterministic identity surface of every PICC. From the host (PCD) perspective these structures behave like read-only registers exposed via Layer 3 / Layer 4 commands rather than via a memory-mapped offset. PCD reader chips (e.g. NXP CLRC663, PN512, MFRC522) implement their own host-side register file behind SPI/I2C/UART — those are vendor-specific and out of scope here.

registers.name: ATQA
registers.description: 16-bit field returned by the PICC in response to REQA/WUPA. Encodes the bit-frame anti-collision bitmap, RFU, UID-size class, and proprietary vendor classification.

fields.name: AC_BITMAP
fields.description: Bit-frame anti-collision bitmap — one of bits 1..5 set indicates which anti-collision variant the PICC supports.

fields.name: RFU
fields.description: Reserved for future use; encoded as 0.

fields.name: UID_SIZE
fields.description: 00 = single (4 B), 01 = double (7 B), 10 = triple (10 B), 11 = RFU.

fields.name: PROPRIETARY
fields.description: Vendor classification — NXP uses these to coarse-classify Classic / Plus / Ultralight / DESFire.

registers.name: UID
registers.access: Read (revealed across Cascade Levels 1..3 via SELECT and SAK)
registers.description: Unique PICC serial number. UID byte 0 = Manufacturer Byte per ISO 7816-6. Cascade Tag 0x88 marks UID not yet complete at non-final Cascade Levels.

fields.name: MANUFACTURER
fields.description: ISO 7816-6 IC manufacturer code (0x04 = NXP, 0x05 = Infineon, 0x07 = STMicroelectronics, 0x08 = Random ID).

fields.name: SERIAL_LSB
fields.description: First 3 (single UID) or 5 (double) or 8 (triple) serial bytes — chip-unique.

registers.reset_value: factory-OTP per chip (except Random-ID mode where UID1..UID3 are randomised at POR)

registers.name: BCC_per_CL
registers.long_name: Block Check Character per Cascade Level
registers.access: Computed by both PCD and PICC; appended to UID-CLn[0..3] at each Cascade Level
registers.description: 8-bit XOR of the 4 UID bytes within the current Cascade Level. Detects single-bit transmission errors in the UID portion.
registers.compute_rule: BCC = UID-CLn[0] XOR UID-CLn[1] XOR UID-CLn[2] XOR UID-CLn[3]

registers.name: SAK
registers.access: Read (PICC reply to final SELECT of each Cascade Level)
registers.description: 8-bit classification byte returned by the PICC after a full SELECT command at each Cascade Level. Bit 3 = 1 means UID is not yet complete (Cascade Tag follows). Bit 6 = 1 means PICC supports ISO/IEC 14443-4 (T=CL).

fields.name: UID_NOT_COMPLETE
fields.description: 1 = subsequent Cascade Level required; UID-CLn[0] was Cascade Tag 0x88.

fields.name: PROPRIETARY
fields.description: NXP variant encoding (e.g. Plus SL2 4K distinguisher).

fields.name: RFU
fields.description: Reserved (per AN10833 note 4: future re-use possible).

common_values_hex.meaning: ISO 14443-4 compliant (DESFire / Plus SL3 / JCOP / Type-4 tag).

registers.name: ATS
registers.description: Length-prefixed structure returned only by SAK bit 6 = 1 PICCs in response to RATS. Encodes maximum PICC frame size (FSCI), wait-time integer (FWI), bit-rate support (DS/DR), CID/NAD support, and historical bytes.

fields.name: TL
fields.description: Total ATS byte count, including TL.

fields.name: T0
fields.description: Bit 8 = TA(1) present, bit 7 = TB(1) present, bit 6 = TC(1) present; bits 5..1 = FSCI (max frame size).

fields.name: TA(1) (opt.)
fields.description: DS/DR bit-rate support bitmap for 212/424/848 kbps.

fields.name: Historical bytes
fields.description: Vendor-specific descriptor (e.g. JCOP / DESFire family ID).

registers.name: GetVersion_Response
registers.description: Across MIFARE Ultralight EV1, MIFARE Plus EV1/EV2, MIFARE DESFire EV2/EV3, MIFARE DESFire Light — 7-byte version frame whose byte 2 (HW/Product Type) deterministically classifies the family.

fields.name: HW_ProductType
fields.description: 0xX1 = MIFARE DESFire, 0xX2 = MIFARE Plus, 0xX3 = MIFARE Ultralight, 0xX4 = NTAG, 0xX5 = MIFARE Classic, 0xX7 = NTAG I2C, 0xX8 = MIFARE DESFire Light.

fields.name: HW_StorageSize
fields.description: 7 MSb encode 2^n storage; LSb cleared if exactly 2^n. Example: 0x1A = 8192 bytes.

registers.name: ATQB
registers.description: Type B equivalent of ATQA + UID + SAK packaged in a single response. Always carries the PUPI (Pseudo-Unique PICC Identifier).

fields.name: PUPI
fields.description: Pseudo-Unique PICC Identifier (Type B analogue of UID).

fields.name: Protocol Info
fields.description: Bit-rate support, max frame size, framing options, FWI.

registers.name: PCB
registers.access: Read/Write (per T=CL block, exchanged each direction)
registers.description: First byte of every T=CL Layer-4 block. Distinguishes I-Block (b8:b7 = 00), R-Block (b8:b7 = 10), S-Block (b8:b7 = 11), and carries a 1-bit alternating block number (b1), CID-present flag (b4), NAD-present flag (b3), and chaining flag (b5) for I-Blocks.

fields.name: Fixed 0
fields.description: I-Block / S-Block fixed to 0; R-Block fixed to 1.

fields.name: CHAINING / S_KIND
fields.description: I-Block: 1 = more frames follow (chained). S-Block: 0 = DESELECT, 1 = WTX.

fields.name: NAD_PRESENT
fields.description: I-Block only; 1 = NAD byte present after CID.

registers.name: CID
registers.access: Read/Write (assigned by PCD at RATS PARAM byte)
registers.description: 0-14 = logical-channel CID used to address one of multiple ISO 14443-4-active PICCs simultaneously in field. 15 = RFU. CID 0 = unaddressed; many PCDs use CID 1 for the single-card case.
